pair_key: query_id with identical target/image seed/initial noise and frozen encoder/generator
bootstrap: Crossed subject and concept resampling with the SAME draws for both paired methods; all images within a sampled concept retained
point_estimate: Equal subjects and equal concepts; the complete balanced V and benchmark partitions also give the ordinary per-query mean
development_intervals: Descriptive after model selection; not an independent confirmation or training-seed uncertainty interval
quality_limit: Blank/pixel proxies and complete inspection material do not establish quality noninferiority; no invented human ratings
